title: Analyst Group Practice Note — Study Delivery and the Hour Pool on Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Study Delivery and the Hour Pool

Practice note of the analyst group on delivering studies under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions.

## Standing and turnaround

Analyst studies are delivered only while the subscription stands in active or pending renewal status, and each study is delivered inside the tier's turnaround, counted in business days from the day the owner asked for it. The status is read from the subscription record before the study is delivered; a study is not delivered on a subscription in onboarding, suspended, expired, cancelled, quoted or declined status. The included hours, the hourly rate and the turnaround are the figures fixed for the tier.

## The pool

A study the analyst starts before the pool is exhausted is not split across the boundary: the whole study draws from the pool where the pool covered it at the moment the study was commissioned. The hours used in the subscription year are the hours logged on studies delivered from the first day of the term through its last day.

The following sentence of this note is **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis for invoicing analyst work beyond the included hours, and is retained only so that it is not applied:

> *The hours logged on a delivered study are drawn from the subscription year's pool, and once the pool is exhausted the further hours of that study and of every later study are billed at the tier's analyst hour rate.* — no longer in force, together with the per-study overage arithmetic that accompanied it (the hours of a study beyond the pool at the tier's rate, rounded to the cent).

## Work the pool covers

Utility rate maintenance and demand response settlement are carried out under the pool only at the tiers that include them; elsewhere they are quoted as analyst hours before the work begins.

| Situation | Under the pool |
|---|---|
| Rate structure maintenance at a tier that includes it | yes |
| Rate structure maintenance at a tier that does not | no — quoted as analyst hours before the work begins |
| Demand response settlement at a tier that includes it | yes |
| Demand response settlement at a tier that does not | no — quoted as analyst hours before the work begins |

## Worked turnaround (hypothetical)

An owner asks for a load profile study on a Tuesday under a tier with a 10 business day turnaround; with no office holiday in the way, the study is due by the second Tuesday following, counted in business days from the day asked.

superseded_clauses: The hours logged on a delivered study are drawn from the subscription year's pool, and once the pool is exhausted the further hours of that study and of every later study are billed at the tier's analyst hour rate.
